## Notes

- Columns are actual barrage points applied to the target after any terrain row shift (SPI 12.33); the printed chart reads these as columns and the results as rows, transposed here so that one record is one cell
- Dice are the sequential two-dice reading (SPI 11.4): first die tens, second die units, 11-16, 21-26, ... 61-66
- pinned: the target battalion-equivalent may not retreat before assault or take part in the assault (SPI 12.44). lose-1 / lose-2: lose that many TOE strength points; infantry and armor are also pinned. Infantry carried in trucks loses one truck point as well (chart footnote)
- Transcribed from the archive.org scan (jp2 96) and cross-checked cell by cell against the 300 dpi community scan of the chart sheet (scan:discord:Shared Charts.pdf:p2); 0 of 108 cells differ. Clay Stone's errata-integrated Land rules PDF contains no chart sheet, so it could not be used for this table
